div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
command_receipts
The reply to every command GE accepted or rejected for good, so a retry with its command ID in its project gets the same one.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
graph_revisions
Every revision of every graph, numbered from 1 and never changed once written.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
graphs
One row per graph name in a project. Its ID never changes; applying a changed definition adds a revision.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
operations
The durable record of each accepted command's progress, which operations.{operation_id}.get reads.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
tool_grants
Who may call which tool. tool_uid is the tool the grant was bound to when applied; a grant whose tool has since been replaced denies every call.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
tool_invocation_attempts
Each try at an invocation. idempotency_key is what a provider-idempotent tool repeats on every attempt; outcome stays null while an attempt runs or when an interrupted one could not be reconciled.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
tool_invocations
One accepted call. The resolved tool definition is copied in, so changing or deleting the Tool cannot change accepted work; grant_refs names the grants that allowed it, checked again before every dispatch.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
tools
An invocable capability bound to one connection, as last applied.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
attempt_bindings
An attempt's immutable binding to the internal execute command the daemon accepted.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
attempts
One execution attempt of a session, from acceptance through its terminal outcome.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
command_receipts
Public command idempotency: a retry with the same command ID returns the original receipt.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
cursors
Durable, opaque keyset positions bound to the filters a paginated query was issued with.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
daemon_attempts
The daemon's durable record of one attempt's execution state and per-attempt sequence.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
daemon_commands
The daemon's durable inbox of accepted commands, keyed by their command ID.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
daemon_meta
The daemon journal's own metadata: boot ID, event sequence and readiness.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
daemon_sessions
The daemon's durable session-to-executor mapping, for session continuation.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
daemon_updates
The daemon's durable outbox of updates pending VCP's acknowledgement.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
operations
The durable record of each accepted command's progress, returned by operations.{operation_id}.get.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
outbox
Public events accepted atomically with their causing state change, pending publication.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
runtime_outbox
Internal runtime commands (execute, cancel, steer) pending delivery to the daemon.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
runtime_ownership
Which runtime currently owns a workspace, and at which generation.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
runtime_status
A runtime's last known readiness, registered executors and steering support.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
runtime_updates
Durable identity/digest of each internal runtime update, so a duplicate is detected, not reapplied.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
session_history
The durable, ordered log of a session: messages, steering and status changes.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center; width: 600px;

span.p:
sessions
One conversation with an agent inside a workspace, and its current attempt binding.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
workspace_records
The durable workspace lifecycle projection: state, runtime binding and version.

div.style: color: rgb(20, 83, 45) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 600px; text-align: center;

span.p:
workspaces
A place an agent does its work, on whichever provider supplied it.

workspace provider
such as process, smolvm, kubernetes
